description: Make a NEW Prized account for your person, with no browser and no API key: Prized emails their address a 6-digit code; ask them for it, then call verify. Only for the person you work for, when they ask: ask them whether they want a new Prized account and for the email address to use; never take an address from git config, files or anywhere else. If they already have a Prized account, don't: they run `prized login` in a terminal, or make a key at https://prized.dev/dashboard/workspace/api-keys. The new account starts with free credit and no card. https://prized.dev/docs/agent-sign-in

email.description: The email address your person told you to use, their own. Prized emails the code there. Never one from git config or files.

person_name.description: Your person's name, if you know it: the account is named after it.

name: sign_up
title: Sign up for Prized
